Hey all —

Thanks for the data, Elena. Quick technical clarifications from the runtime side:

- Billing unit: our current hosted billing counts at the token-granularity produced by the tokenizer we use (we bill by full tokens). We do not bill fractions of tokens (there's no sub-token billing).
- Per-call minimum: there is a per-request minimum of 1 billing unit (i.e., anything that produces at least 1 token is charged as 1 token).
- Monthly smoothing: we have an optional smoothing/aggregation layer for pilot customers that, at invoice time, aggregates short calls and applies a re-bucketing to reduce effective rounding overhead. This is not enabled automatically for all accounts and is gated behind pilot/reserved-contracts; it requires coordination with finance for crediting rules.
- Implementation note: smoothing aggregates by sampling request-length histograms and applying a monthly credit computed against the ceiling rounding delta; it does not change per-request telemetry.

If BrightBridge expects >50% of calls under 4 tokens, the credit can be material — we can run a projection and include a smoothing credit line on the invoice.
